name: chatoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @chatoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @chatoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @chatoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @chatoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @chatoffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @chatoffice/html2docx && npm run test -w @chatoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @chatoffice/pipelines && npm run test -w @chatoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @chatoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run test -w @chatoffice/pptx-ops && npm run test -w @chatoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @chatoffice/chart-kit && npm run test -w @chatoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @chatoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @chatoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @chatoffice/storage-adapter && npm run test -w @chatoffice/service-core && npm run test -w @chatoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @chatoffice/cli && npm run test -w @chatoffice/ui && npm run test -w @chatoffice/ribbon && npm run test -w @chatoffice/mobile-touch && npm run test -w @chatoffice/docs && npm run test -w @chatoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @chatoffice/shell && npm run test -w @chatoffice/slides && npm run test -w @chatoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @chatoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @chatoffice/web-bridge && npm run test -w @chatoffice/server && npm run test -w @chatoffice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/pptx-ops && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/pipelines && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/chart-kit && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/storage-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/service-core && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/cli && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/ribbon && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/mobile-touch && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/web-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/server && npm run typecheck -w @chatoffice/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,html,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,white,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @chatoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chatoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chatoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chatoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chatoffice/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @chatoffice/html" "node scripts/dev-shell.mjs"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @chatoffice/docs && npm run build -w @chatoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @chatoffice/slides && npm run build -w @chatoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @chatoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @chatoffice/html && npm run build -w @chatoffice/cli && npm run build -w @chatoffice/shell
scripts.shell: node tools/patch-dev-electron-name.mjs && npm run build:all && electron apps/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @chatoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @chatoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @chatoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @chatoffice/shell
scripts.dist:server: npm run notices && docker build -f apps/server/Dockerfile -t chatoffice-server:latest .
